indicator: Number of people or households affected
operational_definition: Extract the reported number of people or households affected by the crisis. Preserve the reported population unit and source definition; do not convert between people and households or recalculate the value.
preferred_data_source: Situation reports, rapid assessments, official reports, and humanitarian updates
disaggregation: population unit; location; population group; displacement status; household type where applicable; source
source_problems: Different sources may define affected populations and households differently; people and household counts must not be combined.

indicator: Number of people in need
operational_definition: Extract the reported number of people requiring humanitarian assistance. Do not create a new estimate from sector totals.
preferred_data_source: Humanitarian needs overviews, situation reports, rapid assessments, and official reports
disaggregation: location; population group; displacement status; severity where reported; source
source_problems: People-in-need estimates may use different methods or reference dates.

indicator: Number of people or households currently displaced
operational_definition: Extract the reported number of people or households currently displaced. Preserve the reported population unit and source category such as IDP, refugee, asylum-seeker, or other displaced group; do not convert between units.
preferred_data_source: Displacement tracking reports, registration data, site reports, situation reports, rapid assessments, and official reports
disaggregation: population unit; location; displacement status; sex and age group where reported for people; household type where reported for households; accommodation type; source
source_problems: Displacement categories and counting methods differ across sources; people and household counts must not be combined.

indicator: Number of people or households newly displaced
operational_definition: Extract the reported number of people or households newly displaced during the source reference period. Preserve the reported population unit and do not convert between people and households.
preferred_data_source: Displacement flow monitoring, situation reports, flash updates, rapid assessments, and official reports
disaggregation: population unit; origin; destination; cause; displacement status; sex and age group where reported for people; household type where reported for households; source
source_problems: Values are not comparable if population units or reporting periods differ.

indicator: Number of displaced people who returned
operational_definition: Extract the reported number of displaced people who returned to their area of origin or former residence during the source reference period.
preferred_data_source: Return monitoring, displacement tracking, situation reports, and official reports
disaggregation: origin; return location; displacement status; source
source_problems: Return figures may mix temporary and intended permanent returns.

indicator: Number of people evacuated or relocated
operational_definition: Extract the reported number of people evacuated or relocated because of the crisis. Keep evacuation and relocation labels as stated by the source.
preferred_data_source: Official emergency reports, situation reports, evacuation updates, and humanitarian reports
disaggregation: movement type; origin; destination; source
source_problems: Evacuation and displacement may overlap.

indicator: Number of displacement sites or locations
operational_definition: Extract the reported number of sites, settlements, collective centres, reception centres, or other locations hosting displaced people. Preserve the location type used by the source.
preferred_data_source: Site monitoring, displacement tracking, camp coordination reports, and situation reports
disaggregation: location type; administrative area; source
source_problems: Different site and location types may be counted together.

indicator: Reported accommodation type of displaced people
operational_definition: Extract the accommodation type reported for displaced people, such as host family, rented housing, collective centre, formal site, informal site, public building, or open air. Extract a count or percentage only when stated.
preferred_data_source: Displacement assessments, site reports, shelter assessments, and situation reports
disaggregation: accommodation type; location; displacement status; source
source_problems: Accommodation labels vary across sources.

indicator: Reported primary cause of displacement
operational_definition: Extract the stated main cause or causes of displacement, such as conflict, violence, natural hazard, eviction, housing destruction, loss of services, or livelihood loss.
preferred_data_source: Displacement reports, rapid assessments, protection reports, and situation reports
disaggregation: cause; origin; location; displacement status; source
source_problems: Sources may report several overlapping displacement causes.

indicator: Reported preferred movement intention of displaced people
operational_definition: Extract the stated preferred option of displaced people or households: return, remain, move onward, relocate, or undecided. Extract a count or percentage only when stated.
preferred_data_source: Intentions surveys, displacement assessments, return reports, and situation reports
disaggregation: intention; population group; current location; source
source_problems: Intentions depend strongly on the question and time horizon.

indicator: Number of people reported dead
operational_definition: Extract the reported number of people killed or dead because of the crisis. Preserve the source status such as confirmed, presumed, or unverified.
preferred_data_source: Official casualty reports, situation reports, health reports, and humanitarian updates
disaggregation: casualty status; sex; age group; location; source
source_problems: Casualty figures may be incomplete or use different verification standards.

indicator: Number of people reported injured
operational_definition: Extract the reported number of people physically injured because of the crisis. Preserve any severity category stated by the source.
preferred_data_source: Official casualty reports, health reports, situation reports, and humanitarian updates
disaggregation: injury severity; sex; age group; location; source
source_problems: Injury figures may be incomplete or duplicated across reports.

indicator: Number of people reported missing
operational_definition: Extract the reported number of people missing in connection with the crisis. Preserve whether the figure refers to new reports or active unresolved cases.
preferred_data_source: Official reports, tracing reports, protection reports, and situation reports
disaggregation: case status; sex; age group; location; source
source_problems: New missing reports and active cases may be mixed.

indicator: Number of separated or unaccompanied people reported
operational_definition: Extract the reported number of people separated from family or caregivers, including unaccompanied or separated children when stated.
preferred_data_source: Protection reports, child-protection reports, registration data, tracing reports, and assessments
disaggregation: population category; sex; age group; displacement status; location; source
source_problems: Case counts may not represent all separated people.

indicator: Number of houses or dwellings destroyed
operational_definition: Extract the reported number of houses, homes, dwellings, or residential structures classified as destroyed.
preferred_data_source: Damage assessments, official reports, remote-sensing reports, shelter reports, and situation reports
disaggregation: dwelling type; cause; location; source
source_problems: Definitions of destroyed housing vary across sources.

indicator: Number of houses or dwellings damaged
operational_definition: Extract the reported number of houses, homes, dwellings, or residential structures classified as damaged but not destroyed. Preserve any damage-severity category.
preferred_data_source: Damage assessments, official reports, remote-sensing reports, shelter reports, and situation reports
disaggregation: damage severity; dwelling type; cause; location; source
source_problems: Damaged and destroyed categories may overlap in some reports.

indicator: Number of houses or dwellings reported uninhabitable
operational_definition: Extract the reported number of houses or dwellings that cannot be safely occupied. Do not infer habitability from damage categories unless the source does so.
preferred_data_source: Shelter assessments, damage assessments, official reports, and situation reports
disaggregation: damage severity; dwelling type; location; source
source_problems: Uninhabitable housing may overlap with destroyed or severely damaged housing.

indicator: Number of displaced people or households reported in need of shelter assistance
operational_definition: Extract the stated number of displaced people or households requiring shelter assistance. Preserve the reported population unit.
preferred_data_source: Shelter assessments, displacement reports, humanitarian needs reports, and situation reports
disaggregation: unit; accommodation type; displacement status; location; source
source_problems: People and household units are sometimes mixed.

indicator: Number of people or households living in inadequate or unsafe shelter
operational_definition: Extract the reported number of people or households living in shelter described as inadequate, unsafe, damaged, overcrowded, exposed, or lacking weather protection. Retain the stated condition.
preferred_data_source: Shelter assessments, site reports, displacement assessments, and situation reports
disaggregation: unit; shelter condition; accommodation type; displacement status; location; source
source_problems: Inadequate shelter is defined differently across documents.

indicator: Number of people in hard-to-reach or inaccessible areas
operational_definition: Extract the reported number of people living in areas described as hard to reach, inaccessible, besieged, isolated, or access constrained.
preferred_data_source: Humanitarian access reports, situation reports, logistics updates, and protection reports
disaggregation: access classification; location; displacement status; population group; source
source_problems: Hard-to-reach and inaccessible may represent different levels of constraint.

indicator: Number of locations inaccessible to humanitarian actors
operational_definition: Extract the reported number of communities, settlements, sites, or administrative areas inaccessible to humanitarian actors. Preserve the location unit.
preferred_data_source: Humanitarian access reports, logistics updates, area coordination reports, and situation reports
disaggregation: location unit; access reason; displacement status of population; source
source_problems: Different geographic units should not be combined.

indicator: Reported humanitarian access barrier
operational_definition: Extract the stated barrier to affected people reaching aid or humanitarian actors reaching affected people, such as insecurity, road damage, checkpoints, administrative restrictions, denial, weather, distance, transport, discrimination, or lack of information.
preferred_data_source: Access reports, logistics updates, protection reports, rapid assessments, and situation reports
disaggregation: barrier category; direction of access; location; displacement status; source
source_problems: Access barriers often overlap and use inconsistent terminology.

indicator: Number of roads or routes reported blocked or impassable
operational_definition: Extract the reported number of roads, routes, bridges, crossings, or transport links described as blocked, closed, damaged, or impassable. Preserve the infrastructure type.
preferred_data_source: Logistics reports, access maps, infrastructure assessments, official reports, and situation reports
disaggregation: infrastructure type; status; cause; location; source
source_problems: Routes and individual infrastructure points may be mixed.

indicator: Number of people reached with humanitarian assistance
operational_definition: Extract the reported number of people reached with a specified type of humanitarian assistance during the source reference period. Keep assistance types separate.
preferred_data_source: Response monitoring, situation reports, cluster reports, distribution reports, and partner updates
disaggregation: assistance type; displacement status; population group; location; provider; source
source_problems: Reached figures may double-count people receiving several services or rounds.

indicator: Number of people reported not reached or without assistance
operational_definition: Extract the reported number of people in need who were not reached, cut off, underserved, or without humanitarian assistance. Preserve the source wording and reason when given.
preferred_data_source: Humanitarian needs and response reports, access reports, cluster reports, and situation reports
disaggregation: assistance type; reason; displacement status; population group; location; source
source_problems: Sources may use not reached, underserved, and without assistance differently.

indicator: Number of essential service facilities damaged or non-functional
operational_definition: Extract the reported number of health facilities, schools, water systems, markets, power facilities, communication facilities, or other essential service sites damaged or not functioning because of the crisis. Preserve the facility type and status.
preferred_data_source: Sector reports, infrastructure assessments, official reports, remote-sensing reports, and situation reports
disaggregation: facility type; damage or functionality status; cause; location; source
source_problems: Damaged and non-functional are not equivalent and should remain separate statuses.

indicator: Number of people reported affected by disruption of essential services
operational_definition: Extract the reported number of people whose access to water, healthcare, education, energy, markets, communications, transport, or another essential service was disrupted. Preserve the service type.
preferred_data_source: Sector reports, situation reports, infrastructure assessments, official reports, and humanitarian updates
disaggregation: service type; disruption type; displacement status; location; source
source_problems: People affected by several service disruptions may be counted more than once.
